description: Utility functions and types for handling pasted content in a document editor, focusing on managing marks and links within Slate.js editor.

methods.name: addMarkToChildren
methods.description: Adds a mark to the current active marks, executes a callback, then restores previous state.

methods.name: setLinkForChildren
methods.description: Sets a link href for the duration of a callback, then resets it.

methods.name: addMarksToChildren
methods.description: Adds multiple marks to the current active marks during callback execution, then restores previous state.

methods.name: forceDisableMarkForChildren
methods.description: Disables a mark during callback execution, then restores previous disabled state.

methods.name: getInlineNodes
methods.description: Generates inline nodes with current marks and link context based on input text.
